START_TIME.NAME: StartTime
START_TIME.DESCRIPTION: Scheduled start time for algo execution window (UTC)

END_TIME.NAME: EndTime
END_TIME.DESCRIPTION: Scheduled end time for algo execution window (UTC); must be after StartTime

TARGET_PRICE.NAME: TargetPrice
TARGET_PRICE.DESCRIPTION: Limit price beyond which the algo will not trade; leave blank for market-price tracking

DISPLAY_QUANTITY.NAME: DisplayQuantity
DISPLAY_QUANTITY.DESCRIPTION: Maximum share quantity to display on the order book at any moment (iceberg/reserve size)

MIN_FILL_SIZE.NAME: MinFillSize
MIN_FILL_SIZE.DESCRIPTION: Minimum acceptable fill quantity per execution; rejects partial fills smaller than this

MAX_PARTICIPATION_RATE.NAME: MaxParticipationRate
MAX_PARTICIPATION_RATE.DESCRIPTION: Maximum fraction of market volume the algo may consume (e.g. 0.10 = 10%)

SENTIMENT.NAME: Sentiment
SENTIMENT.DESCRIPTION: Market sentiment bias used to skew intraday participation-rate curve

VENUE_FOCUS.NAME: VenueFocus
VENUE_FOCUS.DESCRIPTION: Preferred liquidity pool selection strategy across lit and dark venues

ALLOW_ODD_LOTS.NAME: AllowOddLots
ALLOW_ODD_LOTS.DESCRIPTION: When enabled, the algo may submit and accept odd-lot fills to improve completion rate

POST_TRADE_ACTION.NAME: PostTradeAction
POST_TRADE_ACTION.DESCRIPTION: Action taken when the execution window closes or the order is fully filled
